left.title: After temporary shutdown, Congress passes two-year spending deal
left.body: After a temporary lapse in government funding that lasted through the night, Congress passed a pricey two-year spending deal early Friday that will also fund the government for an additional six weeks.
left.roundup: President Donald Trump has signed a budget bill approved by Congress to re-open the government after it was briefly closed overnight. The bill will boost spending by about $300 billion over the next two years.

center.title: Shutdown averted as Trump signs budget bill
center.body: President Donald Trump has signed a sweeping budget bill approved by Congress to re-open the government after it was briefly closed overnight.

right.title: House, Senate pass massive budget increase; vote to end gov’t shutdown
right.body: The House approved a stopgap bill early Friday to keep the government open and to boost spending by about $300 billion over the next two years, acting swiftly after the Senate voted hours earlier to ensure that the government shutdown that began at midnight would be short-lived.
